# IJsonRpcDocumentationExporter.ExportDocumentBytes

## ExportDocumentBytes(JsonRpcDocumentation) {#Sisk_JsonRPC_Documentation_IJsonRpcDocumentationExporter_ExportDocumentBytes_Sisk_JsonRPC_Documentation_JsonRpcDocumentation_}

Exports the JSON-RPC documentation to a byte array.

```csharp
byte[] ExportDocumentBytes(JsonRpcDocumentation documentation)
```

### Parameters

`documentation` [JsonRpcDocumentation](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.JsonRPC.Documentation.JsonRpcDocumentation.md)

The JSON-RPC documentation to export.

### Returns

[byte](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.byte)\[\]

A byte array containing the exported documentation.
